name.ja: HGAC 1/144 ガンダムサンドロック

description.ja: 『新機動戦記ガンダムＷ』より「カトル・ラバーバ・ウィナー」の搭乗機、ガンダムサンドロックがHGで登場！
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam W", Gundam Sandrock, the aircraft piloted by Quatre LaBarba Winner, is now available in HG!

description.ja: • ベストプロポーションと劇中ポーズの再現を両立！
description.en: • Best proportions and reproduction of poses from the movie!

description.ja: • 両腕が背中まで届き、ヒートショーテルを背中から抜くアクションが可能。
description.en: • Both arms reach up to his back, allowing him to pull out the Heat Shotel from his back.

description.ja: • 手首はヒートショーテルを斜めに構えられる構造。
description.en: • The wrist has a structure that allows you to hold the Heat Shotel diagonally.

description.ja: • 組み立て易さを追求。計算された関節構造や組むだけで本体カラーを再現できるパーツ分割を随所に施している。
description.en: • Pursuing ease of assembly. The calculated joint structure and parts are divided into parts that allow you to recreate the main body color just by assembling them.
